reads.title: docker-compose.yml — platform
reads.text:
services:
  api:
    build: ./api
    depends_on: [db]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 10s
  db:
    image: postgres:16
# Docker: the api container started before the database accepted connections, so added a healthcheck and a depends_on condition
# verified with docker compose up --wait and a cold start
